The corpus already assessed it: docs/audits/2026-07-24-covariance-kernel-literature-assessment.md classifies it, alongside Sniady, Biane and Dolega-Sniady, as 'supporting; same obstruction' for the Delta_lambda covariance-kernel route, and bean qou-v8t7's attack plan names it directly. I am not re-opening that verdict -- the corpus-grep confirms the assessment stands and the obstruction (character concentration / (dim)^k multiplicities not reaching the mixed-sign target) was subsequently sharpened in 2026-07-25-covariance-kernel-A1-eliminated-dim-threshold.md. What is missing is only the bibliography join: no ref() entry exists for a paper named in a live attack plan.
